title: Atlas 4.0 Hi-Viz Yellow

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Optimized for spirited canyon carvers and urban commuters alike, the Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Hi-Viz Yellow is optimized for upright naked and roadster riders seeking wide-angle road awareness. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell tips the scales at 1410g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~86 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.06 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Bold design with Shockwave Bluetooth audio system and magnetic chin vent.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes with pressure-relief temple channels and contoured removable cheek pads.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Hi-Viz Yellow: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Hi-Viz Yellow: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide

introduction: Positioned in Ruroc's Full Face lineup, the Atlas 4.0 Hi-Viz Yellow brings British engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Hi-Viz Yellow represents Ruroc's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~86 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Hi-Viz Yellow delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
